contents_summary: ZIP with one MP4 member (Video S1, surgical procedure of the FLEX28 DEX electrode for EAS), 102.8 s long, no audio: a title slide, then an operative-field video with a recording-software inset, and split-screen layouts titled After 4, 8 and 10 electrode insertion and After full electrode insertion showing an audiogram thumbnail, a cochlea rendering and CM waveform traces. 21 frames sampled every 5 s were viewed.

frame_blocks.clinical_relevance_notes: Title slide with authorship and institution text; no patient data.
limitations: Frame at 0 s only; later title or credit frames between samples are not viewed.

privacy.burned_in_description: Printed author names and institution and department names on a title slide (not patient identifiers).
privacy.notes: Title slide with printed author and institution names and logos; no patient image, face or anatomy.

frame_blocks.contents: Frames at 5 to 30 s: magnified color operative-field video with a HUD overlay of magnification and distance values at the upper left and an inset recording-software setup screen at the lower right. Frame 2 shows tissue around a small round opening; frame 3 shows a thin translucent electrode array with metallic contacts lying on teal woven fabric; frames 4 to 6 show the same opening at higher magnification with a thin gray lead entering it; frame 7 shows an instrument beside the opening and a pale blurred area at the left.
frame_blocks.clinical_relevance_notes: Operative-field video frames documenting the electrode array and the start of insertion for the patient surgery.

privacy.notes: Operative-field video frame with an inset recording-software screenshot; soft tissue only, no face and no external genitalia or breast.

frame_blocks.contents: Frames at 35 to 45 s: split layout titled After 4 electrode insertion (circled numeral 1) with a small audiogram thumbnail under red text Acoustic Stimuli 500Hz and a vertical red marker line, a dark Cochlea scale rendering labelled 500Hz, a magnified operative photograph of the opening with a lead, and an inset recording-software screenshot with a single waveform trace and a progress dialog. Frame 10 is a partial fade transition with the HUD text overlaid on the layout.
frame_blocks.clinical_relevance_notes: Intraoperative CM monitoring layout after four electrodes inserted, no typed clinical values transcribed; matching Figure 3A of the article.
